The '''SHUKUR-05''' was a light [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]] in production by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FLT" /> The origins of the repeater's name could be found in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Language/Legends|language]], specifically the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] word ''shukur'', which translated to "break" in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

The [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud]], [[Vera Beroya/Legends|Vera Beroya]], carried a SHUKUR-05 light repeater, and made extensive use of it in battle. In combat, Beroya was known to expend the SHUKUR-05's ammunition, before dropping the repeater and switching to her [[Parent/Legends|father's]] [[Mythosaur axe/Legends|mythosaur axe]].<ref name="FLT" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The SHUKUR-05 light repeater was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="FLT" />
